..Title
Resolution Electing 2022-2024 Mayor Pro Tem and Establishing Order of Succession for Acting Mayor
..Body
Whereas, The City Charter, Section 4.3, requires that Council elect a Mayor Pro Tem at its first meeting after the newly elected members have taken office following each regular city election; and 

Whereas, The City Council Rules require the order of succession for Acting Mayor to be established by the City Council in the event that the Mayor and Mayor Pro Tem are not available to serve as Mayor;

RESOLVED, That Council Member Radina be elected Mayor Pro Tem; and

RESOLVED, That the order of succession for Acting Mayor is as follows, through November 10, 2024:

Disch
Song
Eyer
Briggs
Harrison
Watson
Ghazi Edwin
Akmon
Cornell 

Sponsored by: Mayor Taylor and Councilmembers Briggs, Disch, Eyer and Song
